Subject: Varnley Grill Holdings - Quote Request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Varnley Grill Holdings! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have the application, statement of values, and loss runs. The risk fits well within our appetite for restaurant operations at this value level.

I'll work up some competitive options for the January 3rd effective date and aim to have quotes back to you by end of week. If anything comes up during my review, I'll reach out.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
